name: Spell Proc Event
description: Extra proc conditions for aura spells: what school, spell family, proc flags and extended hit conditions must be met for the aura to trigger, plus proc-per-minute rate, custom chance and hidden cooldown. Only first rank spells should be defined, data is propagated to higher ranks.

fields.name: Spell
fields.help: Aura spell with proc trigger, should be the first rank in its spell chain

fields.name: School Mask
fields.help: If nonzero, the proccing spell must match this school mask

fields.name: Spell Family Name
fields.help: If nonzero, the proccing spell must belong to this spell family

fields.name: Spell Family Mask (Effect 0)
fields.help: 64 bit spell family mask the proccing spell must match for effect index 0, 0 = any

fields.name: Spell Family Mask (Effect 1)
fields.help: 64 bit spell family mask the proccing spell must match for effect index 1, 0 = any

fields.name: Spell Family Mask (Effect 2)
fields.help: 64 bit spell family mask the proccing spell must match for effect index 2, 0 = any

fields.name: Proc Flags
fields.help: Overrides the procFlags from Spell.dbc, 0 = use dbc value

fields.name: Proc Ex
fields.help: Extended proc condition (hit result etc.); 0 = trigger on hit/crit only

fields.name: PPM Rate
fields.help: Procs per minute for weapon-speed based procs, 0 = use flat chance from Spell.dbc

fields.name: Custom Chance
fields.help: Custom proc chance in percent, overrides the chance from Spell.dbc, 0 = no override

fields.name: Cooldown
fields.help: Hidden proc cooldown in milliseconds applied to the triggered spell
